name: Pillow
summary: Soft clay Play and Share buttons that sink in, then spring open into a player and share row
about: Two pillowy, soft-shadow circles. Each press sinks the button into the surface, then the circle springs open into a pill with an overshoot. Play becomes a mini podcast player with a morphing play/pause icon, a growing seek bar and a running clock; Share becomes a row of options that show a soft spinner, then a tick with floating puffs. It suits music, podcast and blog pages.
how: Hover: the soft shadow deepens and the icons nudge. Press: the button sinks into the surface.
Play: the circle stretches into a player, the triangle morphs into pause and the title, seek bar and clock arrive one by one.
Pause or play with the same button, drag the soft slider or use the arrow keys to seek, and press the cross to close.
Share: the circle stretches, its icon turns into a cross and four options pop in one after another.
Pick an option: it sinks, spins for a moment, then shows a tick with soft puffs. Escape or the cross squishes it back into a circle.
